name: Thomas' Everything Bagel (Seeds & Garlic WARNING)
whyItWorks: Heavily coated with whole poppy seeds, sesame seeds, dried minced garlic, and dehydrated onion flakes. The whole seeds pass undigested into narrowed strictures, while the concentrated fructans in dried garlic/onion trigger violent gas and spasms.
prepOrOrderInstructions: STRICTLY AVOID. Always choose Plain or French Toast/Cinnamon Swirl bagels without whole seeds.
